def factory(tag):
    def f(a=[], /, b=2, *args, c={'n': 3}, **kw):
        a.append(tag)
        c['n'] += b
        return [a[:], c['n'], args, kw]
    return f
g = factory(1)
h = factory(2)
print(g(), h(), g())
g.__defaults__ = ([9], 4)
g.__kwdefaults__['c'] = {'n': 10}
print(g(), h())
def gen(a=[], *, n=1):
    a.append(n)
    yield a[:]
print(list(gen()), list(gen(n=2)))
